name: pith
description: A lightweight, publishable CMS toolkit for Next.js.

scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/dist .turbo packages/*/.turbo apps/*/.turbo apps/*/.next .pnpm-store .artifacts test-results playwright-report *.tsbuildinfo apps/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.check:release: pnpm check:docs && pnpm bundle:report && node scripts/verify-release-readiness.mjs
scripts.release: pnpm check:release && pnpm pack:check && pnpm --filter @pith-cms/core --filter @pith-cms/next --filter @pith-cms/cli --filter @pith-cms/storage-filesystem --filter @pith-cms/storage-github publish --access public --provenance
